### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in both files are closely related as they work together to address the issue of memory access ordering on the Alpha architecture. The changes in `io.h` define the interface for the relaxed read functions and ensure that memory barriers are applied before the read operations. The corresponding implementations in `io.c` provide the actual functionality of these relaxed read functions, also incorporating the necessary memory barriers. This cohesive approach ensures that the memory access operations conform to the specifications and prevent issues related to reordering, which could lead to system hangs or incorrect behavior, particularly in the context of I/O operations.
